title: 2027 Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant
description: **Use Your Power for Purpose** At Pfizer, your financial expertise and deep knowledge are essential in keeping our products in production and our innovators at the forefront of innovation. Whether you are involved in establishing, coordinating, researching, or managing financial operations, your role is crucial in ensuring our medicines reach the people who need them most, faster and more efficiently than ever before. Your contributions in financial administration, research, and coordination are vital to our mission of delivering life\-saving medicines to patients swiftly and effectively. Your skills and dedication help streamline our processes, making a significant impact on the speed and efficiency with which we can provide essential treatments. **What You Will Achieve** In this Need (Minimum Requirements)** * Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with any years of experience, or an Associate's degree with 4 years of relevant experience, or a high school diploma (or equivalent) and 6 years of relevant experience * Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint * Fluency in English speaking and writing * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Ability to work independently and as part of a team * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail * Effective communication skills, both written and verbal **Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)** * Pharmaceutical industry or contracts experience * System application \& products / SAP experience * Good organizational skills to coordinate and manage multiple priorities * Experience with financial reporting and analysis * Knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements * Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks * Proactive approach to problem\-solving and process improvement Work Location Assignment: Hybrid **Additional Information** * In order to be considered for this position in Ireland you need to be legally eligible to work in Ireland. * Please note there is no relocation support available for this position **How to apply** * Make a difference today, all suitable candidates should apply with CV below. We are looking forward to hearing from you! Purpose **Breakthroughs that change patients' lives**... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives. Digital Transformation Strategy One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience. Equal Employment Opportunity We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees. Disability Inclusion Our mission is unleashing the power of all our people and we are proud to be a disability inclusive employer, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all candidates. We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. Your journey with Pfizer starts here! Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. Requests for any other reason will not be returned. title: 2027 Strategy& Graduate Programme - Dublin
description: **Line of Service** Advisory **Industry/Sector** Not Applicable **Specialism** Corporate and Business Strategy **Management Level** Associate **Job Description \& Summary** **Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact.** At PwC Ireland, we uncover hidden talents, build lifelong relationships, and turn challenges into opportunities. We redefine possibilities for our clients and communities, empowering you to make a meaningful impact that extends far beyond our firm. As part of our team—whether in Assurance, Tax, Specialised Assurance Services, or Consulting \& Deals—you’ll engage in impactful projects with leading clients across diverse industries, contributing to the shaping of tomorrow. From your first day, you’ll be immersed in a collaborative and inclusive culture where your ideas lead to real\-world solutions. Our graduate programme supports your growth at every stage, combining hands\-on experience with structured learning, professional qualifications, and mentorship. This is your chance to grow, innovate, and contribute meaningfully as we work towards excellence together. **Application deadline:** 30th October 2026 **Role Overview:** Strategy\& is a global strategy consulting firm that is part of the professional services network of PwC. Strategy\& has a network of 75\+ offices with 4500\+ consultants around the world. Strategy\& benefits from the broad expertise and international reach of the wider PwC network. The Strategy\& Dublin practice helps organisations develop and implement effective strategies to achieve their goals and objectives. We address key CEO questions on issues such as growth strategy, market entry, mergers and acquisitions, organisation design, performance improvement and value creation. The Strategy\& Graduate Programme provides a structured learning environment to help you develop the skills and capabilities required of a top\-tier strategy consultant. Our programme includes on\-the\-job learning (via hands\-on project experience), learning from others (via Buddy, Coach and Mentor), and formal learning (via induction and regular training sessions). Your first two weeks are induction, which teaches you the basics and develops your network with the Strategy\& and PwC intakes. After the initial two weeks training, you will join project teams and become a core contributor. You will take ownership of defined pieces of analysis and project deliverables, with guidance and support from experienced team members. You will have the opportunity to contribute to discussions in internal meetings with senior team members and will have your voice and opinions valued. Your responsibilities will grow as your experience develops, giving you the opportunity to make meaningful contributions from an early stage in your career. Day\-to\-day, you will work closely with colleagues across different levels of experience, combining analytical thinking, structured problem solving and effective communication to help solve complex client challenges. You will contribute to team discussions, share your perspectives and learn how to translate data and qualitative insights into practical recommendations that create real client impact. **Typical Graduate responsibilities include:** Taking ownership of defined workstreams and project deliverables, while receiving coaching, feedback and support from experienced members of the project team. Identifying relevant data sources and collecting, interpreting and analysing data to generate insights that support strategic recommendations. Conducting interviews and deriving insight from qualitative inputs. Working with project teams to break down complex business problems, test potential solutions and develop practical recommendations for clients Supporting the development of client\-ready presentations and communicating findings to colleagues, clients and senior stakeholders as your confidence and experience grow. Building commercial awareness and developing an understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing organisations across a broad range of industries. Contributing to the wider Strategy\& team through internal initiatives, collaboration, knowledge\-sharing and other activities that support the growth and success of the business. All new joiners are each assigned a buddy who will be responsible for helping you settle in and be there to answer any questions you may have. Alongside this, you will also have a career coach, who will serve as a mentor and support you to ensure you get the opportunities to develop and progress your career at Strategy\&. **Who We’re Looking For:** Our Graduates join us from a range of backgrounds, but all are intellectually curious and highly motivated. We also look for people who bring something more to our work than their academic credentials. For example, the self\-discipline and team\-working skills or leadership qualities gained through work, sporting and volunteering experience. You have a strong academic record and good analytical and problem\-solving skills (minimum 2\.1 degree or equivalent) As a Graduate, you’ll be able to exercise commercial awareness, analytical and interpersonal skills in your day\-to\-day work. Over time, you’ll build the confidence and credibility to present your opinions to clients and senior stakeholders. **Our commitment to you!** At PwC, we recognise that every graduate's journey is unique, and we're committed to supporting your professional growth with benefits that align with your lifestyle and aspirations. Our flexible benefits plan enables you to customise your package, ensuring it meets your individual needs. Whether you're looking to enhance your skills, maintain a healthy work\-life balance, or prepare for the future, we provide the tools and resources to help you succeed. Find out more here . If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact us at ie\_ireland.graduate@pwc.com . **Grow your career with PwC Ireland.** **Education** *(if blank, degree and/or field of study not specified)* Degrees/Field of Study required: Degrees/Field of Study preferred: **Certifications** *(if blank, certifications not specified)* **Required Skills** **Optional Skills** Accepting Feedback, Accepting Feedback, Active Listening, AI Fluency, AI\-Human Collaboration, Business Analysis, Business Opportunities, Business Process Consulting, Business Process Improvement, Business Strategy, Business Transformation, Communication, Competitive Advantage, Competitive Analysis, Conducting Research, Consumer Behavior, Customer Experience (CX) Strategy, Customer Insight, Customer Strategy, Data Analytics, Digital Tooling, Emotional Regulation, Empathy, Go\-to\-Market Strategies, Inclusion {\+ 12 more} **Desired Languages** *(If blank, desired languages not specified)* **Travel Requirements** Not Specified **Available for Work Visa Sponsorship?** No **Government Clearance Required?** No **Job Posting End Date**

title: Access to Care Advisor (Bank Contract) - UPMC Kildare
description: **Access to Care Advisor (Bank Contract) \- UPMC Kildare** **Overview of role:** The Access to Care Advisor will be part of an integrated team across our UPMC healthcare services that will simplify Access to Care for our patients. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with agility and diligence to ensure the success of the Access to Care team in the furtherance of our mission of bringing life changing medicine to all the patients and communities for whom we are privileged to serve. We are looking for a candidate with healthcare experience who is service\-minded and is driven to help others and make the patient experience as straightforward as possible. The candidate will be a team\-player who is adaptable, responsive and learning\-minded in a fast paced environment. They will be organised in their approach and competent in the use of technology to facilitate a collaborative and effective way of working. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities:** Reception, Switchboard and Outpatients Department: Deliver an excellent patient experience to all our patients and stakeholders both internally and externally. Manage all Contractor, Visitor and Patient pathways daily, adhering to policies and procedures and ensuring a professional service is always delivered. Manage car park enquires in conjunction with the Facilities Team. Manage call volumes and progress any queries left via voicemail in an efficient and professional manner. Admissions and Communication: Keep open communication with the nurse in charge on a daily basis. Deal with all telephone calls to the department in a professional and efficient manner and ensure all calls are directed to the relevant people capable of dealing with the enquiry. Collect admissions from reception when requested. Ensure all admissions to department are admitted on iSOFT system and are allocated into correct bed/bay. When necessary, assist with the transfer of patients to other departments or hospitals, ensure all appropriate information is photocopied to accompany patient. Organise clinic appointments, G.P appointments where necessary. **Medical Chart Management:** To ensure the day\-to\-day maintenance of patient medical notes and X Rays. This will include follow up on reports; ensure all test results are filed in patients' chart once signed off by consultant or RMO, in current admission and in appropriate sections in line with hospital medical record policies. To ensure that patient identification details are correct and up to date. To maintain patient confidentiality in respect of held records, in accordance with hospital policy. To prepare notes of patients going to other hospital departments or referring hospitals, as directed by the Clinical Nurse Manager or the Nurse in Charge, and in accordance with policy. Ensure relevant insurance forms are completed by patient. Ensure discharge letters / notes are distributed in a timely manner and filed accordingly. Office Management Duties Ward reception duties, organisation of non\-clinical areas, i.e., nurses' station To complete all administration duties as requested including typing, photocopying, and scanning. Discharge patients on iSOFT computer system and ensure the discharge date and time is correct once the patient has been discharged. Quality \& Safety \- Safe Culture Adhere to the Quality and Safety procedures and protocols to ensure a safe culture. **Health and Safety:** To uphold UPMC Kildare Hospital's policy requirements in relation to Fire, Infection Control and Health and Safety at Work regulations and to attend updates. Identify potential risks for all staff, patients and visitors and adhere to relevant incident reporting procedures. To observe a general duty of care for the health, safety and well\-being of self, work colleagues, visitors and patients within the hospital, in addition to any specific risk management associated. **Qualifications \& Experience:** **Eligible Criteria:** The Post holder must hold the following to fulfil the requirements of this post: Have excellent administrative and organisational skills. Have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with management, consultant staff, staff, patients, public and outside agencies. The ability to work in a fast\-paced customer\-based environment An understanding of commitment to patient confidentiality Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team Ability to work as part of team and own initiative. Time management skills. IT skills, proficiency in: Microsoft Office **Desirable Criteria:** Experience in an acute hospital setting Knowledge of medical terminology IT skills, proficiency in iSOFT Salary: €30,805\.00 \- €46,336\.78 per annum based on a 39 hour work week This job description is intended to be an outline of the areas of responsibility. As UPMC and the post holder develop, this job description may be subject to review in light of the changing needs of the business. **Equal Opportunity Statement and Benefits** **UPMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.** At UPMC we provide a total rewards program that is not only market competitive, but fair and provides growth opportunities for all our colleagues. **Benefits** \- Fully paid maternity and paternity leave for new parents. Competitive Pension Plan, company funded Death in Service Benefit x 3 times. Critical Illness cover for all employees up to the age of 66\. **Performance and Recognition** \- Rewards for performance that supports the goals and mission of UPMC through our annual ACES programme. **Work\-Life Balance** \- Enhanced annual leave up to a maximum of 27 days. Flexible working opportunities to support you to work around external family commitments. **Development and Career Opportunities** \- Opportunities for each employee to reach their career goals through continued learning and/or advancement. **About UPMC** UPMC is a renowned multinational academic medical centre committed to delivering people\-focused care that's close to home. Headquartered in Pittsburgh and affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh Schools of the Health Sciences, UPMC shapes the future of health through clinical and technological innovation, research and education. UPMC expands its expertise globally, bringing world\-class care across continents through its UPMC International division \- an owned and operated network of hospitals and ambulatory care centres in Italy, Ireland and Croatia. UPMC International brings new access to the signature specialty services of UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre, UPMC Sports Medicine and others to more people in more places around the world. In Ireland UPMC has provided high\-quality healthcare in the South East since 2006\. UPMC's operations in Ireland now include UPMC Whitfield Hospital in Waterford, UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic in Dublin, UPMC Kildare Hospital in Clane, and UPMC Aut Even Hospital in Kilkenny. Outpatient care is available at the UPMC Carlow Outreach Centre, UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre radiotherapy locations in Waterford and Cork, UPMC The 4th Practice in Mallow, and across UPMC Sports Medicine Clinics in Dublin, Waterford, Limerick, Tipperary, Cork, and Mayo. UPMC has also established a nationwide Concussion Network. UPMC's Global Technology Operation Centre is based in Kilkenny.

OPW now requires the assistance of additional staff at Civil Engineering Technician Grade I level to support the flood risk management programme. Successful candidate(s) may be placed in any section across the OPW’s Flood Risk Management Divisions. These sections include: • Hydrometric Section • Arterial Drainage Maintenance \& Construction Section • Survey and Coastal Monitoring Section **About the Roles:** **Hydrometric Section** The OPW Hydrometric Section is responsible for the provision, operation and maintenance of a national hydrometric network and dataset and producing hydrometric data (water levels and river flows) and hydrological analysis to support the OPW in fulfilling its functions under the national flood risk management policy and the EU ‘Floods’ Directive. The core operations of the Section are the collection, processing, archiving, analysis and dissemination of hydrometric data. The Role Reporting to an Engineer Grade II or Engineer Grade III, the work of the Civil Engineering Technician Grade I in the Hydrometric Section primarily involves the collection, processing and management of hydrometric data, and the installation, monitoring and maintenance of hydrometric gauging stations. Principal Duties and Responsibilities of the Role The principal duties of the Civil Engineering Technician Grade I in Hydrometric Section are: • Operating and maintaining of hydrometric stations, including calibration, data download/ collection and data validation; • Undertaking flow measurements at hydrometric stations and where required; • Monitoring and maintenance of rain gauges, including calibration, data download/collection and data validation; • Establishing new hydrometric stations and rain gauges; • Installing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of telemetry equipment; • Examining, processing, quality assessing and management of hydrometric and rainfall data; • Supervising operational staff and taking on of duties associated with line management contractors where required; • Planning, setting out and supervision of works on hydraulic control structures and monitoring stations, measurement and recording of works progress, assuming role of Project Supervisor as required; • Undertaking of surveys of rivers, lakes and coastal locations, and associated infrastructure such as embankments and channel structures, and preparing drawings; • Setting out and levelling of construction\-related projects; • Implementing Safety systems and undertaking risk assessments; • Undertaking general administration duties; • Undertaking technical auditing of peers; • Training and mentoring new staff including apprentices, and students on temporary placement; • Developing technical excellence in the use specialised equipment and systems; • Undertaking other field and office duties as required to assist with the performance of the functions of the Hydrometric Section. **Arterial Drainage Maintenance and Construction Section** The Arterial Drainage Maintenance and Construction Section is responsible for the management of the maintenance requirements on drainage schemes completed under the Arterial Drainage Act, 1945 and for the construction and maintenance of capital flood relief schemes executed under the 1945 \& 1995 Arterial Drainage Acts. The Section is responsible also for the maintenance of coastal protection schemes completed under the Coast Protection Act, 1963\. The Role Reporting to an Engineer Grade II or Engineer Grade III, the work of the Civil Engineering Technician Grade I in the Arterial Drainage Maintenance and Construction Section is to provide support to the Engineer in the development, implementation and supervision of all aspects of the maintenance and capital works programmes. Principal Duties and Responsibilities of the Role The principal duties of the Civil Engineering Technician Grade I in Arterial Drainage Maintenance and Construction Section are: • Undertaking surveys of rivers, lakes and coastal locations, and infrastructure such as embankments and channel structures, and preparing drawings; • Setting out and levelling of construction\-related projects; • Investigating of complaints and claims; • Preparing and monitoring of works programmes; • Measuring, supervising and recording of works progress; • Implementing Safety Systems and undertaking risk assessments; • Supervising operational staff and taking on of duties associated with line management and contractors where required; • Supporting general administration duties; • Undertaking other field and office duties as required to assist with the performance of the functions of the Arterial Drainage Maintenance and Construction Section. **Survey and Coastal Monitoring Section** The Survey and Coastal Monitoring Section is responsible for the development and implementation of coastal monitoring programmes, analysis of coastal monitoring data, research and piloting of innovative monitoring techniques and development and management of a coastal defence asset database and asset management system. The Section is also responsible for the inspection of schemes constructed under the Coast Protection Act, 1963\. The Role Reporting to an Engineer Grade II or Engineer Grade III, the work of the Civil Engineering Technician Grade I in the Survey and Coastal Monitoring Section primarily involves the collection, processing, quality control and management of coastal monitoring data. Principal Duties and Responsibilities of the Role The principal duties of the Civil Engineering Technician Grade I in the Survey and Coastal Monitoring Section are: • Undertaking of coastal monitoring surveys and preparation of survey reports and drawings; • Reviewing and quality control of survey data, including data provided by external contractors; • Preparing and monitoring of works programmes; • Measuring, supervising and recording of works progress; • Implementing Safety Systems and undertaking risk assessments; • Supporting general administration duties; • Undertaking other field and office duties as required to assist with the performance of the functions of the Survey and Coastal Monitoring Section. **About You:** Candidates must have on or before 15th of October 2026: 1\. (a) A qualification at minimum Level 6 on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) (or NARIC Ireland Foreign Qualifications equivalent) in Civil Engineering and (b) A minimum of three years’ relevant post\-qualification engineering experience, including relevant experience in two or more of the following areas: \- Surveying \- Civil engineering works \- Hydrometric work \- Geographic Information Systems (GIS) \- Maintaining and operating technical equipment, systems and telemetry. OR 2\. (a) A qualification at minimum Level 6 on the NFQ (or NARIC Ireland Foreign Qualifications equivalent) in a related discipline such as Structural Engineering, Hydrology and Water Resources Engineering, Geographical Information Systems (GIS) and Digital Mapping, Civil and Water Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Construction Management or Construction Studies. and (b) A minimum of four years’ relevant post\-qualification engineering experience, including relevant experience in two or more of the following areas: \- Surveying \- Civil engineering works \- Hydrometric work \- Geographic Information Systems (GIS) \- Maintaining and operating technical equipment, systems and telemetry Candidates must also have: 3\. The ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines with attention to detail. 7\. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. 8\. Excellent oral and written communication skills with fluency in English. 9\. A commitment to achieving quality results and ensuring all tasks are completed to a very high standard. 10\. Good Information Technology (IT) skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. 11\. A commitment to Continuous Professional Development (CPD) including keeping updated and fully informed on developments in relevant areas. 12\. title: Clinical Pharmacist
description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** At UnitedHealth Group and Optum, we want to make healthcare work better for everyone. This depends on hiring the best and brightest. With a thriving ecosystem of investment and innovation, our business in Ireland is constantly growing to support the healthcare needs of the future. Our teams are at the forefront of building and adapting the latest technologies to propel healthcare forward in a way that better serves everyone. With our hands at work across all aspects of health, we use the most advanced development tools, AI, data science and innovative approaches to make the healthcare system work better for everyone. The **Clinical Pharmacist** is responsible for overall drug information research, evaluation and reviews related to the drug discount contracting team and the wider OptumRx Ireland Team. This position is part of a cross\-functional division (e.g., Finance Accounting, Clinical, Legal, Contract Specialist, and Client Management) managing formulary placement strategies for over 60 therapeutic classes to the lowest net cost for OptumRx clients. Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home\-based office in a hybrid work model. **Primary Responsibilities** * Research upcoming drug releases and treatment guidelines, develop and maintain pharmacy programs, such as formulary lists, drug utilization review, prior authorization, health outcomes, disease state management, care management, and other specialty programs. May also include presenting at Pharmacy \& Therapeutics Committee * Interpret pharmacy programs to write clinical guidelines, job aides, and decision trees. Write and collaborate on member/provider collateral materials for pharmacy programs * Work on program implementation teams and contribute to business process design and systems set up, trouble shooting and updates * Review programs for compliance to state, federal and CMS regulations and recommend remediation. Monitor impending legislation for potential impact to current and future programs * Analyze data and prepare management summaries related to work stream results, performance mgmt. results, audit results, CMS reporting, and client reporting * Perform quality audits, determine performance gaps and root causes, prepares reports and collaborates on remediation You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy * Registered pharmacist with the Pharmacy Society of Ireland (PSI) * Proven experience as a pharmacist within retail pharmacy, hospital pharmacy, or pharmaceutical industry environments **Preferred Qualifications** * Proven experience within the U.S. healthcare system and Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) environments * Demonstrated familiarity with drug coverage programs, prior authorization processes, and drug utilization management strategies * Demonstrated advanced clinical training or experience **Soft Skills** * Demonstrated solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interpret, evaluate, and summarize complex information for diverse audiences * Proven experience building and maintaining professional relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, and external vendors **Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.** *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: Optum is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, disability, religion, age, race, and membership of the Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Compliance and Safety Specialist
description: **Role Title** : Compliance and Safety Specialist **Primary Location** : Dublin, Ireland **Reporting to** : Head of Compliance and supporting Head of Safety **ROLE SUMMARY** • The Compliance and Safety Specialist (CSS) is responsible for supporting the Head of Compliance (HoC) in the governance and administration of the compliance monitoring function activities and support the Head of Safety (HoS) as required. • The Compliance function is independent of operational functions. The role involves working closely with the HoC in supporting compliance processes and procedures and compliance management tools across the organisation. • The CSS reports directly to the HoC. The CSS will work alongside the existing team to ensure the optimal integration of current compliance process and tools throughout the organisation. **DUTIES OF THE COMPLIANCE AND SAFETY SPECIALIST INCLUDE BUT NOT LIMITED TO:** • Act as a point of contact in the Compliance department within the broader organisation and functional units; • Provide analytical and technical support in all types compliance issues such as data gathering, training and correspondence with internal and external customers; • Assist in the production of Compliance performance reports based on analysis of CMS data \& information; • Support the HoC in preparing for meetings such as; SSCRB, Management Review and relevant department meetings; • Provide support to departments in carrying out Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Action Plans status, Hazard Identification \& Risk Assessments, and Management of Change; • Maintain the Compliance database and entering new information that arises; • Facilitate and provide support in the training of individuals with Compliance responsibilities at functional level; • Coordinate the integration of Safety \& Compliance management processes by ensuring actions are taking within assigned deadlines; • Assist the HoC in preparation for external audits e.g. IAA, Wyvern etc • Lead the planning of internal audits; • Conduct internal audits on the direction of the HoC; • Raise awareness of responsibilities/activities around Compliance \& Safety activities through publication of promotional material; • Assist with maintaining, updating and publication of the Compliance Manuals; • Assist in the development and implementation of Compliance and Safety Procedures, Centrik workflows; • Ensure that Safety \& Compliance policies and procedures for the organisation are regularly reviewed, updated and communicated to the relevant parties; • Obtain, analyse and disseminate accident/incident occurrence information from other operators and external agencies; • Carry out other projects/tasks as assigned by the HoC to meet the requirements and needs of the organisation. **THE COMPLIANCE AND SAFETY SPECIALIST SHOULD HAVE A GENERAL KNOWLEDGE OF THE FOLLOWING:** • Applicable laws, ICAO Annexes and regulatory requirements; • Airline operational business processes and related terminology; • Typical organisational structure of airlines, including size, functions and relationships; • Safety and Compliance audit principles, procedures and techniques; • Safety management systems, compliance monitoring systems and document management systems; • Emergency Response planning; • Health \& Safety policies and procedures. **THE COMPLIANCE AND SAFETY SPECIALIST SHALL HAVE EFFECTIVE SKILLS IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS:** • Previous internal auditor experience highly\-desirable; • Highly organised and work well in fast\-paced environment; • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present facts accurately and professionally; • Must be able to multi\-task; • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships internally and externally; • Excellent written skills, proof reading, structure, vocabulary with strong attention to detail; • Proficient in computer software programs such as MS Office and relevant database systems used in the conduct of safety management and audit management; • Basic analytical experience; • Data organisation and storage knowledge. **QUALIFICATIONS:** • The Compliance and Safety Specialist is required to have a working knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite. • Knowledge of Centrik for safety reporting, risk management, document control and compliance management is highly desirable. • The Compliance and Safety Specialist will receive internal training as required, to include the following as a minimum: • Company Induction; • Safety Management System; • Compliance Monitoring System; • Aviation Security training; • Internal auditor training; • Aviation Risk Management training; • Emergency Response training; • Document Management System training. **ESSENTIAL CRITERIA** : • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; • Hold a current unrestricted passport; • Provide 3 verifiable references; • 3\-5 years minimum in aviation.

title: Coordinator of Volunteers
description: **Job Title:** **Volunteer Coordinator** **Location:** Tallaght, Dublin **Reporting to:** Volunteer Manager **Contract:** Indefinite duration **Hours:** 37\.5 hours per week **Salary:** €33,000\- €38,000 per annum **About FoodCloud** FoodCloud has a vision for a world where no good food goes to waste, and the only thing bigger than our vision is our drive. We are an organisation of doers driven by kindness, fairness, and a desire to help people and the planet. Would you like to join an organisation that is passionate about tackling food waste and increasing social inclusion in communities across Ireland and internationally? Are you an experienced coordinator who would like to work for one of Ireland's fastest\-growing social enterprises? If this sounds like you, we have the ideal role here at FoodCloud. **About the Job:** Volunteers are the beating heart of FoodCloud, serving as an essential part of our operations to help grow our impact and financial sustainability while controlling operational costs. The Volunteer Coordinator (Community Focus) sits within the Ireland Operations team and reports to the Volunteer Manager. This role is primarily dedicated to our community stakeholders and individual volunteers. You will require strong cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with teams across FoodCloud who utilise volunteer support to enable their work day to day or during targeted periods or events. This role is responsible for recruiting, coordinating and supervising volunteer involvement in these events in collaboration with other internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, during the late summer and autumn, FoodCloud partners with farms to "glean" leftover crops after harvest as part of our corporate volunteering programme. You will support the Volunteer Team to deliver gleaning events throughout the season. **Key Responsibilities** * Volunteer Coordination: Deliver the day\-to\-day coordination, recruitment, scheduling, onboarding, and training of community volunteers to meet FoodCloud's operational needs. * Programme Development: Manage and develop the Community Volunteer programme to foster a positive and inclusive experience. This includes overseeing rewards and recognition programming, volunteer satisfaction, training needs, supply maintenance, and adherence to health and safety regulations. * Communications: Act as the main point of contact for outgoing volunteer communications, including recruitment drives, volunteer satisfaction surveys, newsletters, and pre\-arrival information. * Event Support: Coordinate volunteers for once\-off events and employee volunteering initiatives through cross\-functional collaboration with internal teams. * Systems Management: Champion the effective use of our current Volunteer Management System (Vome) within FoodCloud and provide key input into the ongoing development of the FoodCloud VMS. * Data \& Reporting: Manage data collection and reporting specifically relating to Community Volunteers. * Internal Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams including Hub \& Kitchen Operations, Communications, Community Development, Support and Fundraising to champion the effective management, appreciation and visibility of volunteers within FoodCloud. * Process Enhancement: Identify, develop, trial, and implement new processes to support efficiency and improve the volunteer experience. * Operational Support: Provide flexible backup to the wider team and occasional operational support to the Corporate Volunteer Programme as needed. * Travel \& Flexibility: Undertake occasional travel to Cork and Galway hubs, as well as rural gleaning locations. Infrequent evening or weekend work is required to support events. **Skills \& Experience** * 2\+ years’ programme coordination experience (non\-profit experience is an asset). * Second\-level education required; a third\-level degree or equivalent experience is strongly preferred. * Excellent communication skills to act as a FoodCloud ambassador and engage diverse stakeholders. * Adaptable problem\-solver with a positive attitude in fast\-paced, dynamic environments. * Proactive, innovative self\-starter capable of prioritisation and managing multiple projects and competing deadlines. * Relationship\-builder able to connect with diverse groups, collaborate within a team, and occasionally navigate difficult conversations with volunteers. * Strong presentation skills (experience delivering training or workshops is beneficial). * IT literate, particularly with GSuite. * Willingness to undertake occasional physical work (e.g., lifting produce crates). * Valid, clean full Irish driving licence required (manual preferred); access to a vehicle preferred. * Strong understanding of health, safety, and safeguarding practices. Willingness to complete FoodCloud\-supported Emergency First Aid training (existing certification is beneficial). **Benefits Overview** We’re proud of our people, our culture and the difference we make together. As part of the FoodCloud team, you’ll enjoy: * The role will be based in our Dublin Hub with a focus on maintaining a physical presence during core volunteer hours (9am\-2pm) and we can also offer flexible working arrangements, such as working from home, in line with role requirements. The expectation will be that the successful candidate will work on average 2 days a week from the Tallaght office * 23 days annual leave days plus an additional birthday day off to celebrate you * 10 paid sick days * Paid volunteer leave, a day to support FoodCloud activities and give back to our community * Income Protection * 5% matched pension contribution * Aviva Care including access to an online GP and other health and wellbeing supports * Employee Assistance Programme, including confidential counselling and support * Learning \& development opportunities including study and exam leave * Tax Saver and Bike to Work schemes * Discounted gym, sports club, and sports equipment memberships * Team events, including our summer and winter parties * A supportive, purpose\-driven culture where you can grow, develop and make a real difference We’re passionate about creating a workplace where people feel supported, valued and connected to our vision, mission and values. You can read more about these on our website and on social media channels. If this sounds like your ideal role, we would like to hear from you. development and attainment of clinical competence. * Identifying supports \& learning opportunities, and encourage and facilitate course students to achieve their learning outcomes. * Carrying out summative and formative assessments of course students in collaboration with the Senior Education Coordinator and CNMs. * Setting, correcting and moderating such assignments and examinations as may be determined by the Senior Education Coordinator. * Liaising with the Clinical Practice Support Nurse to meet the needs of the students undertaking the critical care course. * Establishing networking links with other clinical Educators for ICU / critical care across RCSI Hospital group. * Maintaining appropriate records of student progress. **Clinical Practice:*** Demonstrates clinical and professional leadership within the nursing team and acts as a role model for all staff. * Provides effective leadership in promoting, reviewing and developing evidence based nursing practice. * staff to utilize critical reflection to evaluate their nursing practice. * Ensures clinical competence of staff in performing clinical activities. * Provides clinical supervision to postgraduate students, working alongside students \& supporting them in clinical placements. * Participates in the development of an orientation programme for new staff members, and assists with the implementation and evaluation of such programmes. * Works in partnership with the ICU CNM 3 in identifying learning needs for new nursing roles and nursing support roles in the ICU / critical care environment, and developing a process for same. * Ensures that verbal and written nursing reporting systems are accurate and adequate and comply with Beaumont Hospital Guidelines for documenting Nursing care. * Introduces ongoing learning strategies to the unit such as clinical case presentations, tutorials, journal clubs etc. * Supports students undertaking postgraduate education by: o Encouraging learner to apply theory to practice. o Ensuring the competence of all postgraduate students. o Giving support and direction with academic course work.* Carries out development and performance review interviews and career pathway development with individual nursing staff in collaboration with the Clinical Nurse Manager 3\. **Professional practice:*** Provide professional and specialist advice on the provision of a nursing service within the department. * Ensures that the requirements of NMBI for the practice of professional nursing are met and upheld. * Establish and maintain a high standard of nursing practice within the ICU / critical care environment. * Ensure that nursing care is delivered according to local or national policy, procedure, protocol or guidelines **Education and staff development:*** In collaboration with Clinical Practice Support Nurse, assesses and identify training and development needs for nursing staff within the unit; participate in setting objectives for such learning and contribute to the development of training programmes where appropriate, in discussion with CNM3 and Senior Education Coordinator. * Support and assist individual staff nurses to information, interpret the patient’s condition and develop clinical decision making skills. * Keep individual staff nurses informed of their progress and encourage feedback regarding strengths, Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are over the school leaver's age. title: Facilities & Operations Administrator
description: **Job Description** The successful candidate will oversee building maintenance activities in conjunction with our property management provider, manage issues in a professional and timely manner and ensure compliance with operational, health, safety, and environmental standards. Working closely with internal stakeholders across IT, Finance, Procurement, Payroll, Health \& Safety, Sustainability, Travel and Fleet, the role will coordinate service delivery and help ensure business requirements are met across the organisation. In addition, this position plays an important role in supporting the Business Operations function. Responsibilities include providing administrative support across business processes, assisting with logistics and inventory management activities, and providing general support to the Business Operations Manager to ensure the smooth delivery of operational activities and a high standard of customer service. **Responsibilities** Facilities * Act as the main point of contact for all office related queries, liaise with Managers and staff and take a hands\-on approach to ensure smooth running of the office day to day. * Create and maintain a safe working environment for visitors and staff who work within the building by implementing regular inspections and walk throughs of the premises and identifying any potential issues for action. * Coordinate all contractors that attend site and ensure all the relevant documentation is in place prior to the work commencing including necessary permits and risk assessments (RAMs). Ensure Service Inspections are carried out in detail, documented, and executed in a timely and efficient manner in accordance with the criteria detailed in Facilities Contract Attendance Document and ensures efficient management of all 3 rd party vendors. * Act as site safety coordinator \- knows and ensures consistent compliance with Canon’s Health, Safety policies, and procedures. * Act as a part of site Emergency team, as required for emergency control activities. * Co\-ordinate site waste and recycling arrangements. * Co\-ordinate with Security and report any faults on access entry system where necessary. * Ensure that all compliance services for the premises take place and are recorded for ISO certification. * Maintain stock of workplace consumables and manage ordering * Supporting the onboarding of new employees to Canon including arranging new starter packs, including mobile phone and fob and coordinating delivery of laptop. * Other general administration duties that may arise from time to time. Fleet management * Administration of the car fleet processes with knowledge of company car policy and implementation of same. * Manage vendor relationships and employee queries * Coordinating all toll tags, parking tags, insurance and tax disks. * Reviewing and analysing mileage, odometer and fuel reporting for compliance including calculate BIK for all company vehicle drivers, in line with revenue guidelines. Travel Booking * Act as the Travel Champion/Super User for the business in line with the company travel policy. * Monitor travel spend, trends and reporting. * Support users with guidance and escalations * Update travel spreadsheet monthly. Environment * Champion for Ireland to ensure any sustainability programs or procedures are implemented. * Ensuring that the requirements for ISO14001 are in place and of a high standard for auditing purposes. * Participating in internal and external audits. Health \& Safety * To be vigilant to any Health and Safety risks and raise concerns with the relevant department. * Ensuring that site is of a high standard for auditing purposes. * DSE assessor providing relevant, practical advice and guidance, e.g., on workstation set\-up, posture etc. * To be a fire warden and first aider for the site. * Ensure statutory fire testing and associated checks are completed in a timely manner. * Organise staff training Fire Marshal and First Aid ensuring an appropriate number of certified Fire Marshals and First Aiders. * Ensuring that any actions or recommendations raised from risk assessments internal or external are completed to a satisfactory conclusion in a timely manner. Reception * Answer incoming calls from the reception line. * Deal with incoming correspondence from clients/customers/staff ensuring the correct department is contacted. * Monitor reception mailbox responding to all emails within 24 hours. * Carry out Post Room activities including receipt, sorting, and distributing incoming and outgoing post to and from post collection points. * Check that printers and photocopiers are supplied with paper and change toner cartridges when required. * Monitor and maintain stationery levels, ordering stationery as necessary or when requested. * Deliver goods received to correct destination/person. * Administer access control cards and keys for visitors, contractors, and staff. * Allocate company mobile phones. * Organisation of catering for building when requested including customer visits. * Receive, record and lodge all cheques for the business * Raise purchase orders and receipt goods received for payment purposes. * Ensure all expected invoices are received by Account Payable for timely payment. * Validation of all invoices received. * Liaise with AP if there any queries or approvals required. * Make general purchases for the company in line with the purchasing policy after obtaining the required approval (including Capex spend). * Monitor cost reporting and related queries. Procurement * Raise purchase orders and receipt goods received for payment purposes. * Ensure all expected invoices are received by Account Payable for timely payment. * Validation of all invoices received. * Liaise with AP if there any queries or approvals required. * Make general purchases for the company in line with the purchasing policy after obtaining the required approval (including Capex spend). * Monitor cost reporting and related queries. Asset Management * Conduct periodic stock takes and ensure inventory records are accurate . * Validate costs for all assets (storage, disposal etc.) Stock and Logistics Admin * Request asset creations and upload 2nd hand stock to CPQ. * Send monthly update to service and sales. * Liaise with logistics partner to ensure accurate recording of 2nd hand stock and stock for scrap. * Periodic stock take of second hand machines inventory. * Receipting of logistics costs on PPO. * Monitoring of logistics costs. General * Complete all mandatory company training and job specific training required for the role. * Participate in cross\-training and continuous improvement initiatives * Provide backup support for wider Business Operations activities as required. **Qualifications** **Personal Specification e.g. Technical skills, knowledge, experience required** * Organised with excellent administration skills and attention to detail. * Flexible and adaptable, able to work in a fast paced and changing environment. * Self\-motivated. * Able to manage your workload with limited supervision. * Experience of working as part of a team. * Ability to use own initiative, pick new things up quickly and the confidence to highlight areas of concern. * Confident with numbers and the use of excel. * Able to produce reports and analyse data * Good communication skills complimented by the ability to listen to customers, both internal and external. * Intermediate knowledge and application of office applications such as MS Excel, Word, SharePoint, etc. * Clean full driving license and own vehicle required. **Health and Safety** **First Aid** **Fire Marshal** **Fleet Management** **Competencies** * Apply High Standards of Accuracy * Communicate effectively * Focus on the customer * Create solutions to problems * Drive for results * Plan \& Organize Effectively * Take Ownership \& Accountability

title: Field Services Engineer
description: We are working with a growing technology company specialising in **residential and commercial charging infrastructure** , who are looking for a **Field Services Engineer** to join their team. This is a hands\-on technical role supporting the **hardware, software, connectivity and backend systems** associated with installed charging equipment. **The Role:** You will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, both remotely and on\-site, working closely with customers, engineers, suppliers and internal teams. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide 1st and 2nd level technical support for charging equipment and associated software platforms. * Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity and user\-access issues. * Attend customer and project sites to investigate and repair faulty equipment. * Guide customers through remote troubleshooting and corrective procedures. * Manage technical tickets from initial diagnosis through to resolution, working within agreed SLAs and KPIs. * Escalate complex issues to engineering, product, suppliers or field service teams where required. * Manage supplier tickets and RMAs through to completion. * Monitor backend systems and live networks for performance, connectivity and alerts. * Set up and support electrical equipment following installation and commissioning. * Maintain accurate records of technical issues, repairs and resolutions. * Support customer onboarding and provide basic product training. * Manage equipment stock and assist with regular stock checks. **Required:** * 5\+ years' experience in technical support, field service, electrical equipment or a similar technical environment. * Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across both hardware and software. * Good understanding of electrical systems and networking fundamentals. * Experience working with ticketing systems such as Salesforce, Freshdesk, Zoho or HubSpot. * Strong customer service and communication skills. * A proactive, hands\-on approach with the ability to take ownership of issues from start to finish. * Experience with IoT, connected devices, telecoms, energy technology or charging infrastructure is desirable. * Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word and Excel, with strong general PC and IT skills. * Knowledge of OCPP, cloud platforms, APIs or IoT protocols would be advantageous. * **Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel to customer/project sites.** If you have a strong technical background and enjoy **diagnosing problems, working hands\-on with equipment and finding solutions for customers** , we'd love to hear from you.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
description: **Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI\-first world.** Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight. For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work. More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers. We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims. This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open\-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on. If you want **unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product \& platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open\-source platform** , Matomo is worth a serious look. **Why this role matters** Matomo Core is the foundation of our open\-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer\-facing features. It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open\-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem. We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo. As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve. You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open\-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it. **What you’ll own** You'll own problems, not just code. This is not a traditional feature\-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow. You'll own work from problem to outcome: * Understand the problem before committing to a solution. * Help shape priorities, not just implement them. * Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you. * Ship incrementally and learn from real usage. * Measure outcomes and iterate. * Use AI throughout your workflow. **For senior:** You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows. **For intermediate:** You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end\-to\-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade\-offs. **What The Work Looks Like** You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact. Examples include: * Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase. * Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo. * Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on. * Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases. * Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations. * Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection. * Advancing server\-side tracking, data anonymisation and data\-health monitoring. * Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards. * Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use. * Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience. **How we work** We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size. That means we optimise for impact. We value: * Customer problems over technical elegance. * Shipping over endless planning. * Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity. * Ownership over handoffs. * Iteration over perfection. * Clear writing over excessive meetings. * Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture. * AI where it helps us move faster. * Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right. We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it. At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary. **What we’re looking for** **For senior:** You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems. **For intermediate:** You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction. ****You enjoy building products**** You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone. You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses. You naturally ask: * What problem are we solving? * Who has this problem? * Is this the simplest useful solution? * How will we know this made things better? * What should we do if the data shows we were wrong? ****You are comfortable with complex, mature systems**** You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository. You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites. You can balance immediate customer needs with longer\-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified. **You are comfortable across the stack** You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback. Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems. **You use AI as part of how you work** We make heavy use of AI\-assisted development throughout our engineering workflow. You should already be using AI tools regularly or be strongly motivated to do so. We expect Product Engineers to use AI to increase output and quality. AI does not replace your judgment. You remain responsible for product decisions, technical correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and customer impact. **You’ll probably thrive here if** * You prefer owning outcomes over receiving detailed tickets. * You enjoy solving difficult problems in existing systems as well as building new functionality. * You can quickly diagnose complex or intermittent bugs. * You can move from customer feedback or operational evidence to investigation, product decision and implementation. * You care about reliability, performance and data accuracy, not only visible feature work. * You can improve a mature codebase without assuming it needs to be rewritten. * You use AI tools heavily and are actively improving how you work with them. * You are pragmatic: you can make a focused improvement now while recognising when a deeper change is needed. * You can explain technical and product trade\-offs clearly. * You enjoy working across product, engineering, UX, data and customer feedback. * You like small teams where your decisions and output visibly matter. below for **intermediate** only: * You're excited to take on increasingly ambiguous problems. * You want to grow beyond implementation into shaping products and technical decisions. **You may not enjoy this role if** * You mainly want to work on new greenfield products. * You see maintenance, debugging, reliability or performance work as less valuable than feature development. * You want a product manager to define most requirements before you start. * You are uncomfortable investigating problems where the cause is initially unclear. * You prefer replacing existing systems rather than understanding why they work as they do. * You measure success mainly by code quality rather than user or business impact. * You are uncomfortable using AI as part of your normal engineering workflow. * You need a large team, narrow responsibilities, or highly formal processes to be effective. * You prefer polishing a solution extensively before showing it to users. * You dislike writing proposals, documentation, or product notes. * You are uncomfortable balancing speed, backwards compatibility and long\-term platform health. **Remote work** Matomo is a remote company. We work mostly asynchronously and rely heavily on clear written communication. You should be comfortable working independently, documenting your thinking, and collaborating without needing constant meetings. **Location** 100% remote — Germany, UK or Ireland only. **Hiring process** Our process is designed to understand how you think, build, communicate, and use AI in realistic product engineering work. The process usually includes: Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People \& Culture interview → Technical skills interview → Final technical interview. We do not expect unpaid multi\-day projects. We want to understand how you approach ambiguous problems, make trade\-offs, use AI, and ship useful product improvements. **Diversity and Inclusion** InnoCraft (trading as Matomo) values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products. **Interested?** If you care about solving meaningful customer problems, improving software that people depend on, working with high ownership, and making privacy\-friendly analytics more secure, reliable, accurate and useful, we’d like to hear from you. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all\-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. Full\-time. **Location** Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. **The selection process** In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long\-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Graduate UI Designer
description: **About Kooba** --------------- Kooba is an award\-winning digital agency specialising in creating high\-performing digital experiences for ambitious organisations. We work across UX, UI, strategy and technology, partnering with clients to create websites and digital products that look sharp, work brilliantly and deliver results. We’re looking for a **Graduate UI Designer** to become part of our Dublin design team. We want an eager designer near the beginning of their career. Someone who’s ready to learn from an experienced team and get their hands on real client projects from day one. **The Role** As a Graduate UI Designer, you'll work alongside our UI/UX designers, developers and project teams to help create engaging, accessible and highly usable digital experiences. Become an essential part of the design process, from exploring early visual ideas and concepts through to detailed interface design, responsive layouts, design systems and final production\-ready designs. We don't expect you to know everything yet. We're looking for someone with strong design fundamentals, attention to detail and, most importantly, the appetite to develop quickly. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Designing engaging and intuitive website and digital interfaces. * Creating responsive layouts across desktop, tablet and mobile. * Working primarily in **Figma** to develop concepts, interfaces and prototypes. * Supporting senior designers in developing creative concepts and visual directions. * Building and maintaining components and design systems. * Applying typography, colour, imagery, layout and interaction principles effectively. * Working with UX designers to turn research, wireframes and user journeys into polished interfaces. * Collaborating closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented to a high standard. * Learning how to design with accessibility and universal design principles in mind. * Taking part in design reviews, critiques and project workshops. * Presenting and explaining your design thinking internally and, as you develop, to clients. * Keeping up with developments in digital design, technology and AI\-enabled design tools. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- You may be a recent graduate in **Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, Digital Design, UX/UI** or a related discipline. We care more about the quality of your portfolio and how you think about design than the title of your degree. We're looking for: * A strong eye for visual design. * Good typography, layout and composition skills. * An understanding of designing for digital rather than simply applying graphic design to a screen. * Some experience with Figma. * An understanding of responsive web design. * Curiosity about UX and how people actually use digital products. * Strong attention to detail. * An interest in accessibility and inclusive design. * The ability to take feedback positively and improve your work. * Good communication and collaboration skills. * Curiosity about emerging technology and how AI is changing the design process. * A genuine desire to build a career in digital design. **Your Portfolio** ------------------ Your portfolio is an important part of the application. We're not looking for years of commercial work. College projects, personal projects, concepts and self\-initiated work are all welcome. We'd particularly like to see work that demonstrates **strong visual thinking, typography, layout, digital interface design and attention to detail**. Where possible, show us some of the thinking behind the finished design — not just the final screens. **What You'll Get** ------------------- You'll join an experienced design team where you'll have the opportunity to learn quickly and develop your craft. You'll get: * Mentoring and support from experienced UI/UX designers. * Exposure to a wide range of clients, sectors and digital challenges. * The opportunity to work on live projects from an early stage. * Regular feedback and design critique. * Experience working alongside UX, development, strategy and client teams. * Training and professional development opportunities. * A clear opportunity to progress as your skills and experience develop. **The Person We're Looking For** -------------------------------- We're interested in people with potential. You should care about the details, be curious about why things work, enjoy learning from other designers and be prepared to challenge yourself. You won't be expected to arrive as a finished designer. We want someone with the foundations to become an excellent one. If you're ambitious about building a career in UI and digital design, we'd like to see your work. Please email it to ui\_careers@kooba.ie along with your CV and why you feel you would be the right fit.
