title: Technology Strategy and Transformation (TS&T) Consultant
description: **Location: Dublin** **Career Level: 9 (Specialist/Consultant)** **About TS\&T Ireland** Technology Strategy and Transformation (TS\&T) a key part of our growing Digital Core service. Here, we develop company\-wide IT and digitalisation strategies that exploit ground\-breaking technologies and strategically advise our Fortune 500 CIO clients on how to reinvent their IT operating models, enterprise and data architectures, take advantage of cloud, and improve the value they are getting from their IT investments. Our practice has been consistently rated as the best team in the industry by the Financial Times based on client ratings and was key for Accenture to be named a leader by Forrester. **The Opportunity for You** We are looking for a motivated technology and business consulting professional to join our growing Technology Strategy and Transformation practice. This role is suited to candidates who want to build their experience helping clients shape and deliver technology\-led reinvention across the Digital Core. You will work alongside experienced consultants and industry specialists while developing your own expertise across technology strategy, AI enablement, architecture, digital foundations and transformation delivery. This role is suited to candidates who bring a strong consulting foundation and experience across several areas of technology strategy, architecture, AI enablement, digital foundations, technology effectiveness, and transformation delivery. We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every area; we value thoughtful generalists who can connect business priorities, technology choices, delivery realities, and measurable value outcomes while continuing to be curious about learning. In this role, you will help clients define, shape and deliver technology products, platforms, operating models and transformation programmes that unlock business value, improve agility and accelerate outcomes. You will work closely with client stakeholders, business and industry specialists, engineering teams, architects, designers, analysts, partner vendors and delivery teams to create practical, high\-quality outcomes. **What you will help clients do:** - Support and drive strategic advisory projects, programmes and workstreams from shaping through to delivery, keeping stakeholders aligned, informed and focused on outcomes. - Help clients define how technology functions can create business value through effective operating models, product and platform structures, governance, organisation design and ways of working. - Contribute to developing transformation strategies, business cases and roadmaps that are pragmatic, actionable and linked to measurable value - Assess current\-state maturity across areas such as architecture, agile delivery, modern engineering, operating models, governance, AI readiness and technology ways of working. - Support the assessment of AI and emerging technology opportunities on how these will impact IT operation modes, architectures and transformation deliveries - Guide practical adoption of AI in the software development lifecycle, helping teams reduce delivery cost, improve engineering effectiveness and accelerate time to value. - Provide clear updates on progress, risks, issues, actions and dependencies to support effective decision\-making. **What you will do:** - Work with business and technology leaders to define technology strategies, future\-state roadmaps, and practical transformation plans. - Help clients build AI\-ready digital foundations across data, cloud, infrastructure, platforms, enterprise architecture, and modern delivery practices. - Assess technology estates, operating models, delivery capabilities, resilience, cost, and value to identify opportunities for improvement. - Support complex transformation programmes by helping teams establish governance, manage risk, track value, and maintain delivery momentum. - Collaborate across business, technology, data, engineering, infrastructure, managed services, and ecosystem partners to create joined\-up solutions. - Conduct research, analysis and assessments to support technology strategy and transformation engagements. - Develop presentations, reports, business cases and recommendations for client stakeholders. - Support workshops, stakeholder interviews and working sessions. - Gather and analyse information to identify opportunities, risks and improvement actions. - Work with multidisciplinary teams to translate strategy into actionable outcomes. **Experience Requirements:** - Solid experience in consulting, technology strategy or technology transformation teams (typically 3\+ years). - Proven track record supporting technology programmes. - Experience managing client relationships and stakeholders. **Core skills we expect everyone to bring:** - AI awareness and curiosity: a practical understanding of how AI, data, and automation are changing businesses, technology functions, and delivery methods. - Strong communication and storytelling: the ability to explain complex ideas clearly, tailor messages for different audiences, and build confidence with stakeholders. - Project and change skills: experience helping teams plan, organise, govern, and deliver change in complex environments. - Business and technology judgement: the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, value, risk, cost, and feasibility. - Collaboration and adaptability: comfort working across multidisciplinary teams, learning new domains quickly, and contributing beyond a narrow specialism. - Structured problem solving: the ability to break down ambiguity, identify options, build evidence\-based recommendations, and move work forward. **Experience across several of these areas:** Candidates should bring experience in some of the areas below and demonstrate a willingness to build broader capability across multiple domains. These are the kinds of things our teams do; they are not all mandatory requirements for every candidate. - Technology strategy and architecture: shaping technology vision, business technology strategy, enterprise architecture, future\-state roadmaps, and investment cases. - AI, data, and digital foundations: supporting AI adoption, data strategy, agentic or AI\-enabled platforms, cloud and infrastructure strategies, enterprise SaaS, and modern digital core design. - Technology modernisation and resilience: assessing legacy estates, defining modernisation pathways, improving resilience, and sequencing practical architecture roadmaps. - Technology effectiveness and value: improving technology operating models, FinOps, cost optimisation, AI\-enabled software delivery, engineering productivity, and value tracking. - Transformation delivery: supporting large\-scale technology programmes, transformation offices, governance, planning, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realisation. - Ecosystem and platform collaboration: working with major technology platforms, cloud providers, software vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to shape integrated solutions. **Who will thrive in this role:** - Generalists who enjoy connecting ideas across strategy, architecture, delivery, AI, data, operating model, and business value. - People who are comfortable with ambiguity and can help clients move from broad ambition to practical next steps. - Consultants who are comfortable working collaboratively with clients and teams, communicating clearly and contributing positively to shared outcomes - Candidates with curiosity, learning agility, and the confidence to contribute across several areas while deepening expertise over time. **Important Note On Requirements** This is intentionally not a checklist of mandatory must\-haves. We expect candidates to demonstrate the core consulting, communication, AI awareness, project, and change skills described above, and to bring meaningful experience across several of the capability areas. We welcome candidates who can learn quickly, collaborate broadly, and apply good judgement across a range of client challenges.

title: Life Sciences Attorney (Full Time, Remote Position)
description: **About VeraSafe:** VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys with healthcare and life science experience to join our data protection and privacy practice. This is a fully remote position. **Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!** **Apple Podcast** : **https://apple.co/4b28hwE** **YouTube** : **https://www.youtube.com/@PrivacyInPractice/videos** **Spotify:** **https://bit.ly/4moSMU7** VeraSafe is proud to be **certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 95% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work** . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work\-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description. **VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.** **We encourage you to apply directly through LinkedIn, where every application is reviewed by a member of our team. To ensure we can devote our time to carefully reviewing each application, we are unable to respond to emails regarding this opening.** **About the Role:** This is an excellent opportunity for anyone who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in\-demand area of law at the intersection of privacy and life science. We are inundated with business from clients in the life science and pharmaceutical space who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!). We have found our strongest team members don’t necessarily have prior experience in privacy law. You’ll begin with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation). **Note** : There is a 1\-3 hour skills assessment associated with the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way. We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on\-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top\-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out. The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem\-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply! **Responsibilities include:** * Leading the data protection aspects of a clinical trial from start to finish * Assessing study protocols for privacy issues * Conducting data protection impact assessments * Reviewing CTAs, ICFs, and privacy policies * Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments * Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda * Writing clinical trials, GCP, and privacy law related articles and blog posts * Assisting in the development of in\-house legal templates * Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies * Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community **What We Need From You** **Need to have:** * License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction * At least three years of work experience as an attorney * An interest in privacy and technology * Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise * Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail * Ability to work remotely * Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners * Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM) **Nice to have:** * Experience working in a law firm * Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience strongly preferred * Experience/training in privacy law * Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.) * Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.) **Key Competencies** * Detail\-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic * Tech\-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines * Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments **VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:** * Work from almost anywhere with Wi\-Fi * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid holidays * Annual bonuses * Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E) * Flexible working schedule in some roles * Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket * Company laptop provided **Other Benefits:** * Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche * The chance to have a long\-lasting effect on a small but growing international business * Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions * Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe **Our HR Privacy Notice is available at the following link:** https://verasafe.com/legal/human\-resources\-privacy\-policy/
